description: Dim_Documents full reload from РегистрСведений.А_ДокументРасшифровка (Stage v2 2026-05-05). Drill-down dimension for Fact_PnL.Document_ID FK. Captures ERP doc number/type/date + BuhBud counterpart type/number from hardcoded mapping.

extractor.raw_sql: SELECT r._Fld56032_RRRef AS Document_ID, r._Fld56038 AS Document_Number_ERP, r._Fld56036 AS Document_Type_ERP, r._Fld56039 AS Document_Date, r._Fld56035 AS Document_Number_BuhBud, r._Fld56037 AS Document_Type_BuhBud, r._Fld56034 AS Document_Presentation, r._Fld56033 AS Document_Comment FROM _InfoRg56031 r UNION ALL SELECT CAST(0x00000000000000000000000000000001 AS varbinary(16)) AS Document_ID, '' AS Document_Number_ERP, N'(Empty)' AS Document_Type_ERP, NULL AS Document_Date, '' AS Document_Number_BuhBud, '' AS Document_Type_BuhBud, N'(Empty)' AS Document_Presentation, N'' AS Document_Comment WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM _InfoRg56031 WHERE _Fld56032_RRRef = 0x00000000000000000000000000000001)
